Name: Pierre Sprinklers
Author: Bluejal
Description:
This mod gets Pierre to sell sprinklers in his shop in Stardew Valley 1.6. 

You will need to have [b]Content Patcher[/b] installed in your mods folder for this to work. If you don't have it yet, you can download it [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]from here[/url].
[b]SMAPI[/b] is also required, of course, which can be downloaded [url=https://smapi.io/]here[/url].

If you prefer, you can have sprinklers available to buy at JojaMart instead of, or as well as Pierre's, with [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21212]Joja Sprinklers[/url][/i].

If you encounter any issues or have any feedback please do let me know.
